public_rationale: The ordinary technical reading is supported. OpenAI reported meaningful safety improvements, but those did not establish reliable alignment with broadly shared human values. This supports substantial remaining difficulty, not a numerical estimate of how many years a solution would take.
limitations: The evidence includes research organizations' own assessments rather than a field-wide proof.

our_interpretation: The supplied normalized proposition isolates the state of technical knowledge. The separate assertion that this is the only solution is not graded here.
The ordinary reading of a long way is that substantial foundational problems remained, rather than a forecast of a particular number of years.
Consensus human values means broadly shared human values reliably reflected in machine behavior across relevant situations.
For this ongoing research-state observation, the target is the publication month through March 14, 2023. Research has no standard reporting quarter.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous research documents substantial unresolved problems in reliably aligning powerful systems with human values, with no established validated general solution.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An established and validated method available at publication reliably implements broadly shared human values across relevant situations, leaving only routine implementation work.
